paper_description: Dual gates are used to tune the photoluminescence intensity in single-layer WSe2 transistors, achieving an on-off ratio up to 90 and a blue shift up to 36 meV.
Reports spectroscopic measurements indicating observation of a stable charged-boson state in TMD structures, opening a path for room temperature superconductivity.
Presents observation of IX gases in hBN/WSe2/hBN/p:WSe2/hBN structures, with IX energy differing by 82 meV due to hBN spacer thickness.
Studies macroscopic dynamics of a polariton condensate in a ring-shaped microcavity trap, measuring polariton-polariton interaction strength.
Investigates light-matter interactions controlled by optical topological transitions in hyperbolic metamaterials, increasing spontaneous emission rates.
Demonstrates strong coupling and formation of microcavity polaritons at room temperature in 2D materials for practical polaritonic devices.
